name: GET /api/crm/activities/calls - Read the call/voicemail timeline
description: Read the call and voicemail entries on one encounter's timeline, newest first, optionally narrowed to a kind (call|voicemail) or a call_disposition. Only telephony activities are returned — note/email/meeting/task entries are excluded even though they share the crm.activity table. Edge cases: 400 when the encounter_id query param is missing; an unknown encounter yields an empty array rather than 404, since this is a filtered read not a record fetch; limit defaults to 50 and offset to 0; entries logged manually (no external_call_id) appear alongside webhook-sourced ones. actor_kind=human|ai_agent narrows to activities by people or by AI voice agents (anything else is 400); every row carries actor_kind, ai_agent_id, ai_agent_version_id and ai_disposition. AI CALLS (0892cb5b-f0d4-43a5-b3db-770361137b1b#AC2 — CRM call activity records actor ai_agent, agent version, summary and disposition): actor_kind is human (default) or ai_agent. An ai_agent activity must carry ai_agent_id and ai_agent_version_id (uuids — the sdk-voice-agent agent and the exact published version that handled the call, so a later prompt change never rewrites history) and may carry ai_disposition (the agent's own outcome, 1-64 chars, e.g. meeting_booked / callback_requested), kept beside call_disposition which stays the telephony outcome; summary holds the post-call summary. sdk-voice-agent writes these automatically when an AI call linked to a crm_encounter_id ends (external_call_id voice-agent:<call_id>, so a re-report updates rather than duplicates). A human activity must not carry any ai_* field (400). The emitted crm.call.* event payload includes actor_kind, ai_agent_id, ai_agent_version_id and ai_disposition. Enforced in the DB by activity_ai_agent_ref_check (sdk-crm migration 009).
